edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production as set forth below. Defendant’s responses are based on information reasonably available at this time and are made without waiver of, and subject to, all applicable objections, privileges, protections, and immunities.
edits.name: Revise preliminary statement

edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks information or documents protected from disclosure by the attorney-client privilege, attorney work-product doctrine, common-interest doctrine, or any other applicable privilege, protection, immunity, rule, statute, or order. Defendant further objects to each request to the extent it is overbroad, unduly burdensome, not proportional to the needs of the case, seeks documents not within Defendant’s possession, custody, or control, or seeks information that is not relevant to any party’s claim or defense.
edits.name: Revise general objections

edits.text: 2. PRODUCTION. Subject to and without waiving the foregoing objections and any specific objections, Defendant will produce non-privileged documents responsive to Plaintiff’s requests that are within Defendant’s possession, custody, or control after a reasonable search, to the extent such documents exist and are located.
edits.name: Revise production statement

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent Defendant withholds responsive documents on the basis of privilege or protection, Defendant will identify such documents on a privilege log in accordance with the applicable rules, any governing case-management or protective order, and any agreement of the parties.
edits.name: Revise privilege log statement

edits.text: 4. RESERVATION. Defendant reserves the right to amend, supplement, or correct these responses and objections as appropriate, including based on subsequently discovered information, documents, or legal authority.
edits.name: Revise reservation of rights

edits.text: PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production as set forth below. These amended responses are based on information reasonably available after reasonable inquiry and are made without waiver of applicable objections, privileges, protections, and immunities. Defendant will not rely on general objections to withhold documents unless expressly stated in a specific response below.
edits.name: Preliminary Statement revised for compliance

edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant preserves the following objections to the extent applicable to particular requests: attorney-client privilege, attorney work-product protection, common-interest protection, privacy/confidentiality obligations, overbreadth, undue burden, lack of proportionality, lack of relevance to any claim or defense, and lack of possession, custody, or control. These objections are incorporated only where specifically referenced in an individual response, and any responsive documents withheld on the basis of an objection are identified in that response or will be reflected on a privilege log where applicable.
edits.name: General Objections limited

edits.text: 2. SEARCH AND PRODUCTION. Defendant will conduct a reasonable search of locations and custodians reasonably likely to contain responsive documents within Defendant’s possession, custody, or control, including relevant human resources, payroll/compensation, and management files and reasonably accessible electronic mail and shared-drive materials for agreed custodians during the relevant time period. Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents on a rolling basis and will substantially complete production by March 20, 2026, subject to entry of an appropriate protective order for confidential personnel, compensation, and business records and subject to supplementation as required by the applicable rules.
edits.name: Production date and scope added

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. To the extent Defendant withholds responsive documents on the basis of privilege or work-product protection, Defendant will identify such documents on a privilege log in accordance with the applicable rules, any governing case-management or protective order, and any agreement of the parties. Defendant need not log communications exclusively between Defendant and its counsel after commencement of this litigation unless required by court order or agreement.
edits.name: Privilege log clarified

edits.text: Defendant reserves the right to amend, supplement, or correct these responses and objections as required by the applicable rules. This reservation does not limit Defendant’s obligation to state, in each individual response, whether responsive documents are being withheld on the basis of an objection.
edits.name: Reservation narrowed

edits.text:
REQUEST NO. 1: All documents concerning Plaintiff’s employment with Defendant, including hiring, job duties, performance, discipline, compensation, leave, complaints, and separation.
RESPONSE TO REQUEST NO. 1: Defendant objects to this Request to the extent it seeks documents protected by the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, or other applicable protection, or documents outside Defendant’s possession, custody, or control. Defendant further objects to the extent the Request is overbroad because it is not limited to claims or defenses in this action. Subject to these objections, Defendant will produce non-privileged responsive documents located after a reasonable search of Plaintiff’s personnel file, HR records, payroll/compensation records, and reasonably accessible ESI for relevant custodians. Defendant is not withholding non-privileged responsive documents based on these objections except as to documents outside its possession, custody, or control, privileged/protected materials, and materials beyond the claims and defenses in this action.
edits.name: Individual response RFP 1 added

edits.text:
REQUEST NO. 2: All communications concerning Plaintiff, Plaintiff’s employment, Plaintiff’s complaints, or Plaintiff’s separation from employment.
RESPONSE TO REQUEST NO. 2: Defendant objects to this Request to the extent it seeks privileged or work-product protected communications, is overbroad, unduly burdensome, not proportional to the needs of the case, or seeks communications unrelated to the claims or defenses. Subject to these objections, Defendant will produce non-privileged responsive communications located after a reasonable search of reasonably accessible ESI for relevant custodians for the period relevant to Plaintiff’s claims and Defendant’s defenses. Defendant is withholding privileged/protected communications and communications outside the relevant scope described in this response.
edits.name: Individual response RFP 2 added

edits.text:
REQUEST NO. 3: All documents concerning policies, procedures, handbooks, or guidelines applicable to Plaintiff’s employment or to the claims and defenses in this action.
RESPONSE TO REQUEST NO. 3: Defendant objects to this Request to the extent it is overbroad or seeks policies not applicable to Plaintiff or not relevant to the claims or defenses. Subject to these objections, Defendant will produce non-privileged responsive policies, handbook provisions, procedures, and guidelines applicable to Plaintiff or the issues in this action that are located after a reasonable search. Defendant is withholding documents outside that scope.
edits.name: Individual response RFP 3 added

edits.text:
REQUEST NO. 4: All documents concerning damages, mitigation, compensation, benefits, payroll, bonuses, equity, or other remuneration relating to Plaintiff.
RESPONSE TO REQUEST NO. 4: Defendant objects to this Request to the extent it seeks documents not relevant to any claim or defense, documents outside Defendant’s possession, custody, or control, or confidential third-party information. Subject to these objections and an appropriate protective order, Defendant will produce non-privileged responsive documents sufficient to show Plaintiff’s compensation, benefits, payroll, bonus, equity, and other remuneration information relevant to the claims and defenses. Defendant is withholding documents outside that scope and privileged/protected materials, if any.
edits.name: Individual response RFP 4 added

edits.text:
REQUEST NO. 5: All documents concerning any investigation, complaint, report, or proceeding relating to Plaintiff or the allegations in the Complaint.
RESPONSE TO REQUEST NO. 5: Defendant objects to this Request to the extent it seeks privileged or work-product protected materials, confidential information concerning non-parties, or documents not relevant to the claims or defenses. Subject to these objections and an appropriate protective order, Defendant will produce non-privileged responsive documents concerning investigations, complaints, reports, or proceedings relating to Plaintiff’s allegations that are located after a reasonable search. Defendant is withholding privileged/protected materials and documents outside the scope stated above.
edits.name: Individual response RFP 5 added
